tech_stack.frontend: React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS v4 + React Router v7
tech_stack.backend: Firebase Cloud Functions v2 (Node 20) + Firestore + Storage + Auth

binding_invariants: All app reads/writes go through adapter (app/src/lib/backend/). No direct Firebase SDK in components.
Every entity write uses adapter.db.mutate() — atomic: entity + auditEvent + version + searchIndex.
VIEWER is read-only — enforced in Firestore rules AND in every Cloud Function.
All Anthropic calls live in functions/. Browser never calls Anthropic API.
AI responses must cite source documents. Free invention is a bug.
refId and form-number chips are load-bearing display elements. Never strip them.
No hard-coded hex outside app/src/index.css. Use var(--color-*).
Model IDs defined once in functions/src/runtime.ts. Never claude-fable-5. Sonnet 5 rejects sampling params.
